top_signals.title: India Sitharaman Aims to Keep Up Spending to Sustain Growth
top_signals.summary: India will keep up its spending on roads and bridges to ports to sustain economic growth while maintaining fiscal prudence, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said, as she begins preparations for the next federal budget.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The Atlantic Brief: After the U.S. Midterms, Trans-Atlantic Defense Cooperation
top_signals.summary:
Date: Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026Time:  12:00 – 1:00 p.m. ESTThe third joint webinar by RUSI and War on the Rocks: Two leading defense publications from both sides of the Atlantic present their expert panel.Overview:For this edition of The Atlantic Brief, the Royal United Services Institute and War on the Rocks present a dialogue on the future of trans-Atlantic defense cooperation following the U.S. midterm elections. Participating experts from the United Kingdom, continental Europe, and the United States bring decades of first-hand experience in the armed forces, diplomacy, and foreign policy.The panel will explore what the midterms mean for U.S. force
